events.title: Major update: new interface, Act 2 map and a refreshed demo
events.summary: Next Fest means a lot to us, and everyone who played the demo these days made a difference. So we used the festival to ship RUNECAST's biggest update yet. Here are the highlights. ONE CONSISTENT INTERFACE Every screen now follows the same standard: the title in the same place, your balance in the corner, BACK on the left and the main action in gold. Menu, map, forge and battlefield are cleaner and easier to read. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46275085/0b5c2f8c0c6581e580ac9d3ab1e39e81a0a39762.png REDRAWN HE

events.summary: The rune chooses. You command. The RUNECAST demo has a new look. We have reworked its animations, interface, and battle feedback, with fixes inspired by players' reports. events.title: The Runecast is Live
events.summary: The rune chooses. You command. The RUNECAST demo is available now, free, in English and Portuguese. What's in it All of Act 1: 10 waves at the Palisade, from the first goblin to the Witch. The start of Act 2: the Iron Maw, up to the Web Queen. 4 heroes (Dwarf, Archer, Healer, Rogue) and their 8 evolutions. 8 findings to equip, the rune forge and the Tome with the bestiary.
